units.source_text: 千重子一走进店铺，就热心地观看成溜挂在右边、重叠着的女服绸料。

en.t: As soon as Chieko entered the shop, she eagerly looked at the rolls of silk fabric for women's clothing hanging in rows on the right, overlapping one another.

units.source_text: 这不是龙村的织品，而是“钟纺”的产品。

en.t: These were not fabrics woven by Tatsumura, but products of Kanebo.
